# Plan: peer-messaging

Goal: Make sofar the addressing layer for Claude Code cross-session messaging: where a collision surface already names a colliding session, also name it as a reachable peer so Claude can warn it with its OWN SendMessage — sofar never posts, never opens a socket, never calls a model (felt-cost D3 intact). Plus close the jurisdiction leak: a finding arriving by message is not recorded until it is recorded. Strictly best-effort per BD22 — the ~/.claude/sessions/<pid>.json registry is UNDOCUMENTED, so any absence, parse failure, or shape change omits the address and degrades to exactly today's behavior.

Progress: 5/5 tasks done (100%)
